title: Clamped Continuous-Treatment Means When the Threshold Crosses an Inverse-Exponential Design Hole
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded tier 'incremental' against target 'field': under the bar; no bounded fix in scope.
gap_reasons: The note proves a uniform bandwidth equivalent and matching risk and honest-length orders, but only for a known, exactly specified inverse-exponential density, fixed smoothness parameters, and publicly deterministic thresholds.
The distinctive shoulder inference result is only order-sharp; the local experiment and exact minimax expected-length constant are explicitly left open.

[D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.9 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the uniform moving-bandwidth equivalent, critical coefficient 6, and matching risk and honest-length orders in the declared Bernoulli model; the math referee passed. D0.5 graded the delivered package incremental below the field floor, and its two citation-positioning findings were repaired after the halt. An exact expected-length constant would require a separate uniform two-direction local-experiment comparison and Holder modulus analysis; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: A continuous-treatment clamp creates the observed functional \(\psi_{\delta_n}(P)=E_P\{Y\mathbf 1(A>\delta_n)\}+F_\gamma(\delta_n)\mu(\delta_n)\), whose atom term requires point estimation at the public threshold. Published clamp identification, together with the separately maintained measurable all-dose bridge, supplies only a conditional causal interpretation and is not a solve target. When the threshold moves through an interior inverse-exponential treatment-density hole, the usual local-density approximation fails across a narrow displaced shoulder. The main theorem gives an explicit composite equivalent for the exact local-mass bandwidth uniformly over every deterministic threshold sequence, including a proved hyperbolic-sine profile for the exact-mass bandwidth and \(h_n\sim6\log\log n/(\log n)^2\) when \(\beta=\gamma=1\) and \(|\delta_n-1/2|=1/\log n\). A total finite-sample connected interval is uniformly honest, and explicit localized-bump and global-shift Bernoulli pairs certify the matching minimax order \(n^{-1/2}+F_\gamma(\delta_n)h_n^\beta\). The publishable increment is the explicit moving exponential transition.
gap: Fixed-point inverse-exponential regression rates are known, and spatially varying rates are known under polynomial zeros or local doubling. None of the checked results explicitly inverts the moving local mass when a threshold window crosses or skirts an inverse-exponential hole.
fill: The project proves uniform endpoint bounds, a three-region composite inverse with a displaced hyperbolic-sine shoulder, the coefficient \(6\) at the critical sequence, and an exact-mass honest clamp interval whose matched observed-functional order is certified by explicit Bernoulli testing pairs and their product \(\chi^2\) bounds.
